english: Wow, it's like we really came to another world.\nThat startled me.
I wonder if we've come to a different world\nfrom [NOEL] and the others?\nI'm worried~...
If Tsubasa-san's here, everything'll be absolutely fine!\nI guarantee it!
I just hope [NOEL] isn't being\nany trouble for Tsubasa-san...
Does anyone recognize this world?
It's similar to the world I was in.\nAh, but... a little different, maybe.
Unyuu, it's totally different\nfrom my world~.
Sorry, I don't recognize it either...
I see. Then let's ask the townspeople.\nFirst we need to find out what kind of place this world is\nbefore we act.
Huh? Me?\nBut............ Hmm, well...
Hm? What's wrong?
Um, how about I find a passerby\nand go ask them a few things?
Huh, really?
It might be my fault we're here—\nI said something weird, after all.\nAnd being totally useless on top of that... y'know.
Besides, talking to people\nisn't exactly my weak point.
Huh?
Ah... yeah, I figured no one\nsees me that way at all...
Still, it'd help. Just ask someone\nfor a bit of info, that's all.
Got it.\nI'll be back in about ten minutes.
//Fade to black: time passes.\n//Background: town at noon. Claude alone.
I... I got lost...
Where am I...?\nI wandered way too far just 'cause no one was around...\nWhich way was everyone? Which way?
...When in doubt, keep it simple?\nJust go wherever the hot babes are...?
N-no, that makes no sense whatsoever...
Huh? Ride the skateboard over there?\nWhy would I do that?
If I stand out, Remu-san and the others might find me?\n...Maybe, but\nI bet you just wanna try it...
Besides, I've never even\nridden a skateboard before.\nSomething that dexterous is beyond me...
H-huh? Hey, this is actually working!?
//Claude rides off on the skateboard.\n//Riko's silhouette appears for an instant.
//Scene change.\n//Claude speeding along on the skateboard.
I think I came from around here...\nWait, is this really the right way?
//The bomb activates. A voice comes from the pursuing guard robots.
THAT SKATEBOARD HAS\nA BOMB PLANTED IN IT.
Hm? Did I just hear a weird voice...?
GAGAGA...!
What's that...? Wh-what is it?\nWhat's chasing me!?
GETTING OFF THE SKATEBOARD\nOR SLOWING DOWN\nWILL CAUSE AN EXPLOSION.
A b-bomb-rigged skateboard!?\nIt blows up if I slow down... no matter what I do,\nI'm gonna die, aren't I!?
//SE: gunshot.\n//The guard robot is shot and destroyed.
GOGH!? MAIN CAMERA DAMAGED!\nTAKING FIRE!!
Huh...?
//[Event art] Aria hanging upside-down\nfrom a parachute, firing her gun.
What's that? A girl just dropped out of the sky...!?
You idiot over there!\nTell me the situation!
U-um... apparently this skateboard\nhas a bomb planted in it.\nIf I get off or slow down, it explodes...
Copy... I'm getting you outta this!
Huh!? She's charging straight at me???
Butei Charter, Article 1!\n'Trust your comrades, aid your comrades'—\nHere I come!
Grab on!!
//SE: rapid gunfire, then an explosion. Screen flashes white,\nthen fades to black.\n//Event art off.
Ugh, what happened...?\nI remember a girl diving down from the sky...
We took the blast wave mid-air\nand got blown all the way here, that's what.
That's insane...
You're alive, right?\nI bet you're hurting all over, but tough it out.
Ngh? Owowow... my arms, my legs, my face—everything hurts!
Quiet! Think about the situation a little!
S-sorry,\nKanzaki H. Aria-san...
...Hmph, so you've got enough composure\nto read my name tag, huh.
Um, why are you wearing a name tag?
It's the opening ceremony today, duh.\nIf you're a new Butei High student,\nyou should know that much!
Huh? I... um...
Forget that—look,\nwe're surrounded by enemies...!
Huh...?
//A swarm of Noise surrounds the building\nwhere Aria and Claude are.
I've been shooting them this whole time and nothing works!\nWhat ARE those things!?
Ah, those are Noise!?\nThis is bad... normal attacks\ndon't work on them...
You know what those things are?
Y-yes. You see, those are...
//Fade to black: time passes.\n//Battle map: around the school.
...Singing, transforming—\nit all sounds like a joke.\nBut you've got no reason to lie, huh.
You believe me?
So, where's this Hibiki girl\nwho can beat the Noise?
Well, I got lost,\nand thanks to that skateboard\nI have no idea where I am...
Got it. I'm going.
Huh?
I'll break through the encirclement.\nAfter that, yell or do whatever it takes—\nI'll find that Hibiki girl no matter what.
Until then, you hide.
No—I'll be the decoy and jump out.\nWhile they're distracted, Aria-san,\nyou break through the encirclement.
Huh? Do you even hear yourself?\nYou're unarmed!
That's exactly why I'll be the decoy.\nIf you went out, Aria-san,\nI couldn't cover you at all...
Well... that's true.
I have fought the Noise before,\nso maybe I can\nkeep running for a little while...
I-I don't wanna die either, y'know!\nHiding here, getting found,\nand tortured to death—no thanks...
Fine. We'll go with your plan.\nNow, go!!
Huh, right now!? Waaah!?
//Claude moves forward.
Uh, h-hi... Mr. Noise...
E-eep!? They're scary after all!!
//The Noise's attention turns to Claude.\nFrom here on, they target Claude.
If he's gonna stand out that much,\nas a decoy he's flawless...
//Battle continues.\n//Aria reaches the destination.
Good. Broke through the encirclement.\nNow for that Tachibana Hibiki girl...
Huh!?
//Ambush Noise appear around Aria.
Dammit!?
Aaah, I-it's hopeless!!
Idiot! Don't you dare give up on your own!
That's right! Don't give up on living!
//The transformed Hibiki appears on the map.
[CLAUDE]-san!\nYou were taking so long I came to get you!
Hibiki-san!
Girl over there! Can you hear my song?\nIf you can hear it—fight!
This is the song that protects us, right?\nEither way, in this situation, I'll believe!
Thank you!
Counterattack, start! I'll blow a huge hole in 'em!
//Battle continues.\n//Noise can now be attacked; objective changes\nto wiping out the enemy.
Something showed up.\nGiving off serious killer vibes?
Is it an enemy?
Obviously it's an enemy.\nJust look at it!
That unnecessarily huge chest is the proof!\nEnemy, no matter how you look at it! Enemy!
THAT'S what you can tell just by looking!?
(I wish we could understand each other...)
//Battle continues.\n//Deal a set amount of damage to Black Broom.
//Black Broom retreats.
Don't you run away! You silent, useless-tits, deadpan woman!!
But Aria-san,\ndo you even have bullets left...?
Tch. Can't be helped...
//■Battle end.\n//Background: town at noon.
...Anyway,\nlooks like I owe you one.
No no! I'm just glad you're safe!\nSo, [CLAUDE]-san,\nwho is this...?
Hold on. Introductions later.\nMore importantly, you two...
Who the hell are you!?
Um, why the sharp glare...
I heard the story from this wimp,\nbut you two are way too suspicious!\nComing from another world and whatever.
Huh? But you said you believed us...?
Whether you're trustworthy is another matter!\nYou're gonna tell me the whole story,\nso you're both coming with me!
Where to?
Butei High. Questions later!
//Scene change.\n//Background: in front of Butei High.\n//Meru and Remu. They met Riko and were brought here.
...So this is Butei High?\nI just followed along, but\nit looks like a normal school.
You really don't know, huh.\nSimply put, this is\na school that trains Butei.
What is a 'butei'~?\nUm... you were Mine Riko-san, right?
Just Riko is fine~\nDrop the stiff formalities!\n[MERU]-chan♪
Y-yes~...\n(She's so hyper~...)
A Butei is an armed detective!\nEvery Butei High student is a Butei.\nPretty amazing, right?
Is that so~? St. Mont Blanc Academy\nalso required combat skills, but\nthat's not normal~?
Not normal, I'd say...?
Riko's a Butei High student too!\nI'll show you around!
Will you really help us?
If something weird was going on,\nButei High's Inquesta (detective division)\nwould've caught wind of it already.
Riko's in Inquesta too,\nso leave that to me! \nMaybe there's already word about the missing kids~?
I hope [CLAUDE]-san and Hibiki-san\nare all right~...
//Aria, Claude, and Hibiki arrive in front of Butei High.
Ah!
[CLAUDE]-san!\nWhere'd you go~!?
So Aria was looking after you.\nA fated meeting, perhaps?
Don't say stupid stuff.\nSo, what? These guys your friends?
Yes!\nThis is Remu-san and [MERU]-chan!
Since Riko's wearing the same uniform,\ndoes Butei High have a middle school division too?
Middle school!?\nI'm a second-year high-schooler!!
Huh!? You're a year older than me!?\nI totally thought you were younger...
Shut up shut up shuuut up!\nAnyway, everyone's coming with meee!
//Scene change.\n//Background: classroom inside Butei High.\n//Shirayuki appears.
Nice to meet you.\nI'm Hoshika Shirayuki, Butei High's student council president.
I've heard the story.\nYou supposedly came from another world...
It's obviously a lie! No way!
Huh? Didn't you believe\nthat story?
I don't recall believing anything about coming from another world.\nThat's way too out there, even so!
Now now, Ariaaa.\nSounds interesting, doesn't it? Let's hear 'em out~.
I haven't completely believed\nyour story either, but...
It's hard to be believed without proof, isn't it.\nBy the way, may I ask\nsome questions of my own?
Of course.
I heard that here you can hire help\nfor investigations and solving cases—\nis that true?
Yes. A Butei is an armed detective\nlicensed to use force against violent crime,\nwho takes contracts from civilians to investigate cases.
Hm, same as a normal detective in that respect.
If every Butei High student is a Butei,\ndoes everyone carry weapons?
Carrying guns and blades is a student's duty.
Like handkerchiefs and tissues~...
The uniforms are bulletproof, y'know!\nGetting shot a little won't even faze us!
Whoa...
Then you must all\npractice martial arts too, right?\nCheck this out!
HWACHAAA!
What is that...?
A Jeet Kune Do stance!\nHWAH!!
//Event art: Hibiki watching a Bruce Lee video.
Following my master's style,\nI learned martial arts from watching movies!
The Dragon's the best, after all!
You'd die doing that on a battlefield.
//Event art off.
Huh!? No good!?\nBut it's the coolest martial art in the world,\ntaught to me by my master...
I see—so your skills are the real deal.
By the way, contracting a Butei\nrequires payment.\nThis ain't charity~.
Well, if they're armed and\ntake on life-or-death jobs, that's only natural.
So, what is it you'd like our help with?
Let's see... first I need to confirm\nwhether people suddenly vanishing from this world—\nlike mysterious disappearances—has been happening.
Mysterious disappearances?
This actually happened in our world.\nLike I said earlier, we came here\nfrom a different world.
I got thrown into Remu-san's world,\nand then thrown here from there!
I want to know\nwhether that's been happening\nin this world too.
Missing-persons cases? There are tons of those.\nBut whether any of 'em are the\nunreal kind you're talking about, I couldn't say.
There's confidentiality to consider,\nso disclosing information would be difficult.
I'm a detective myself,\nso I understand those circumstances.
Then, how about we contract with a Butei\nand have you assist our investigation?
That, I think, is possible.
Really!?
Butei Charter, Article 9! Take flight across the world.\nRegardless of race or nationality, fight as one!
In other words, anyone from anywhere\ncan contract a Butei!\nVui!
I wonder if the contract fee could be paid later?\nI don't exactly have\nthis world's currency on hand.
Regarding that—\non the condition that you stay at Butei High,\nwe'll guarantee your living expenses for the time being.
Really!?
Butei Charter, Article 3! A Butei must be strong.\nBut before that, be righteous.\nA Butei is an ally of justice, see!
In exchange, we will be\nkeeping an eye on your movements.
...Naturally. I don't trust you.
Did we do anything suspicious?
...That bomb-rigged skateboard you were riding.\nThat's the 'Butei Killer's' handiwork.
The 'Butei Killer'...?
A criminal who targets Butei.\nThey were arrested before,\nso this is likely a copycat.
I just happened to ride it by accident!
Can't explain it. But my gut tells me\nyou guys are connected\nto the Butei Killer.
Your gut...
No proof, so we can't prove our innocence.\nNot unless we catch\nthat Butei Killer or whatever.
Yes-yes! Riko just\ncame up with a niiice idea!
Riko nominates Aria\nas these people's caretaker!
Hah!?
Aria suspects [MERU]-chan and the others, right?\nThen you should look after them\nup close!
Two birds with one stone, right?
That may be a good idea.\nIf I recall, Kanzaki-san has already\nearned her graduation credits.
Like hell!\nWho'd be a caretaker!?
Hmm, then maybe Riko'll volunteer?\nRiko's nice, unlike Aria,\nso I'll dote on them all☆
Don't be an idiot!\nLike I'd leave it to YOU!
Then Aria's gotta do it, right?\nDecided!!
Including me, the other students\nall have classes...
...Fine.\nI'll do it, all right, I'll do it!
But if I see even a hint of anything suspicious,\nI'll ventilate you—be ready for that!
Y-you wouldn't shoot at school... right?
Shooting outside the range is\n'not to be done more than necessary,' that's the rule.
'Not more than necessary'... so\nit's fine to shoot if it's necessary!?
Why the surprise~?\nIf armed guerrillas attacked,\nnot being able to fight back would be a problem~?
([MERU]-chan...\nhas she seen more action than I'd think...)
Now that that's settled, pack your bags\nand move to the prison!
Prison...?
No, it's a normal classroom?
You startled me~...
But you'd best not get any funny ideas,\nfor your own sake, 'kay?
They call her Quadra—Aria of the twin blades and twin guns!\nThe strongest S-rank Butei\nin the all-combat Assault division, y'know?
Is S-rank amazing~?
Aria's caught criminals\n99 times in a row.\nYou'll never get away☆
...Be ready, got it?
Um... excuse me,\nwh-why are you glaring at me...?
Because YOU'RE the most suspicious!!
Good grief... what'll become of us.
//END
